title: Sharjah Publishers Conference 2022
summary: Rights meetings with publishers from around the world, ahead of the Sharjah International Book Fair.
body:
The Publishers Conference brings publishers, literary agents and rights professionals from around the world to Sharjah, ahead of the Sharjah International Book Fair, for discussions on the industry, B2B meetings and rights negotiations.

[Our look back at the Publishers Conference](/news/looking-ahead-to-the-sharjah-international-publishers-conference/)
